about: A MySQL command-line client with autocompletion and syntax highlighting.

prs.title: SQL files with DELIMITER blocks now run
prs.broken: Feeding mycli a SQL file that changes the delimiter, as every database dump with a trigger or stored procedure does, failed at the first one and the rest never ran.
prs.changed: mycli now handles the DELIMITER line the way the standard mysql client does.
prs.matters: People can restore their database dumps with mycli.

prs.title: A use line without a semicolon no longer eats the next statement
prs.broken: Scripts often write use db without a semicolon, as the mysql client allows. Piped into mycli, that line swallowed the next statement and the run stopped with an unknown database error.
prs.changed: mycli now ends use and source lines at the newline, the same way the mysql client does.
prs.matters: SQL scripts written for the mysql client run the same in mycli.
